rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from Nevada State Board of Nursing–approved CE providers (the board publishes how to check provider approval); 120 documented preceptor hours = 10 CEUs, max 10 per period
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 30 hours for the first biennial period after graduation, but must still do the cultural competency course and the one-time bioterrorism course.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of the most recent 2-year period; board recommends keeping CE certificates at least 4 years and the bioterrorism certificate indefinitely.

topics.who: Nurses who provide or supervise emergency services in a hospital or primary care; due within 2 years of starting such work (HIV stigma and bias)

rules.notes: Renewal also needs nursing practice or NCLEX within 5 years, else a refresher. Late fee $100, no grace period.
rules.rule_quote: The 4 hours of continuing education is part of the mandatory 30 hours already required by law (NRS 632.343).
